02 / CORRECTNESS BEFORE CONFIDENCEEIGENVALE RESEARCH · SUMMER 2025

Find the signal.
Test the system.

A quantitative research engine over roughly 3.5 million price observations.

I built a Python/NumPy/Polars platform generating 15–20 rolling factors, constructing constrained long/short portfolios, and simulating trades.

Availability timestamps, point-in-time joins, lagged execution, and roughly 30 tests protect against look-ahead bias. Vectorized calculations cut a research run from roughly 12 minutes to 2.5 minutes.
